{{Otheruses|Protectorate}}
{{Quote|Since the planet is uninhabited, the moon of Pantora reserves the right to continue as its protectorate.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], regarding Orto Plutonia|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
A '''protectorate''' was a system of government where a territory was controlled by a foreign government while remaining autonomous. [[Moon/Legends|Moons]] had the right to claim their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as a protectorate providing that they were uninhabited, and were able to establish military installations on them to protect them. Prior to the discovery of its indigenous [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] population, the planet [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] was a protectorate of its moon, [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. After making first contact with the Talz and determining that they were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], representatives of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] conceded control of Orto Plutonia to the Talz.<ref name="Trespass" />
